name: hris-onboarding-nest-gcp
description: Lab / portfolio HRIS + employee onboarding: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Keycloak/OIDC, React web, Flutter mobile.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev:api: npm run prisma:migrate -w @hris/api && npm run start:dev -w @hris/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hris/api && npm run build -w @hris/web-admin && npm run build -w @hris/web-onboarding && npm run build -w @hris/web-landing
scripts.start:all: npm run db:up && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed && echo 'Run: npm run dev:api  |  npm run dev:admin  |  npm run dev:onboarding'
